campus_notes: Dimensions compiled 2026-08-12 from a research document cross-referenced with UIUC housing floor plans and student-sourced specs. UIUC does not publish an official per-room ft x ft table; where the source gave a range or only square footage, a representative ft x ft was used (data_confidence: medium). Multi-room suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Undergraduate beds are Twin XL. Room shapes shift across floors, corners, and architectural cuts (L-shaped/window-alcove variants). Standard usable clearings and structural minimums provide the tier baselines below. Closets are ~3 x 3 ft structural drop-ins. On 2026-11-14 the group entries were split into the 15 undergraduate residence halls listed by University Housing (https://housing.illinois.edu/living-communities/halls/undergraduate), each carrying its hall style's typical room sizes (traditional: single and double; newer premium: double); the triple is added only where the hall's page lists triples or shows a triple floor plan.
